name: stockflow-optimization-study
description: The StockFlow two-sprint capture (F1 + F6, same scope as stockflow-full) re-recorded under the OPTIMIZED v0.3.9 per-turn model matrix, as a paired baseline for the turn-tuning study. Differences from stockflow-full: (1) tuned models , navigator-assess=opus, navigator-red=sonnet+low WITH the test-state-ownership canon, driver-green=opus+medium, driver-refactor=opus; (2) every agent turn carries a full pre-turn .consort snapshot under replay-set/pre-consort/ (the recorder change that lets a replay lay pre-turn cycle state verbatim); (3) a CLEAN run , zero HIL escalations (F1's empty-state story, which HIL'd on a shared-DB whole-table assertion before the canon, was re-authored isolation-aware and passed green + review). 147 recorded turns. Recorded timestamps were gap-cleaned: the ~2.6h operator idle from a mid-run rollback+resume (the S2 re-author) was surgically removed by uniformly shifting every resume-era timestamp, so the timeline reads as one continuous ~3.78h run. Sprint 1 ships F1 stock-visibility (record-stock form + stock-by-location home + SKU detail); sprint 2 ships F6 split-tracking-code as a 3-story expand/contract refactor on live data. Intake owns its bytes under intake/.

features.summary: additive: record-stock form + stock-by-location home table + SKU detail view
expand/contract refactor (3 stories): add batch_number+serial_number + backfill (S1), drop the combined inventory_code column (S2), expose batch/serial in the read UI (S3)
